description:
Configure the WooCommerce Storefront sidebar to improve navigation. 

Starting from the WordPress Admin Dashboard:
1. Navigate to Appearance > Widgets.
2. Locate the 'Sidebar' widget area.
3. Remove ALL existing widgets from the Sidebar.
4. Add ONLY these three widgets in this exact order:
   - 'Product Search'
   - 'Filter Products by Price'
   - 'Product Categories'
5. Configure the 'Product Categories' widget to enable 'Show product counts'.
6. Ensure changes are saved.

Do not add any titles unless they are default. Do not change other widget areas.
